title: M3 training-only PPG transit-delay artifact / M3 仅训练折 PPG 传导延迟制品
description: Strict contract for a median ECG-to-PPG transit delay fitted on an explicit training roster. It is an evaluation alignment artifact, not a denoising operation and not a deployable subject-specific calibration. / 在明确训练名单上拟合 ECG 到 PPG 中位传导延迟的严格合同。它是评价对齐制品，不是去噪操作，也不是可部署的受试者个体校准。

schema_version.description: Exact runtime artifact schema ID. / 精确运行时制品 Schema ID。

artifact_id.description: Stable ID derived from the training-subject hash and fitted sample delay. / 由训练受试者哈希与拟合样本延迟派生的稳定 ID。

sampling_rate_hz.description: Evaluation-grid sampling rate. / 评价网格采样率。

delay_samples.description: Median following-pulse delay in samples. / 后继脉搏中位延迟，单位样本。

delay_sec.description: The same delay in seconds; validator checks delay_samples/sampling_rate_hz. / 同一延迟的秒值；validator 检查 delay_samples/sampling_rate_hz。

fit_subject_ids.description: Exact sorted training-subject roster. / 精确排序训练受试者名单。

matched_delay_count.description: Number of physiologically bounded training delays supporting the median. / 支撑中位数的生理界内训练延迟数量。

minimum_delay_sec.description: Lower physiological delay gate. / 生理延迟下界。

maximum_delay_sec.description: Upper physiological delay gate. / 生理延迟上界。

fit_role.description: Leakage barrier: only a training role may produce this artifact. / 防泄漏边界：仅 training 角色可生成此制品。

source_reference.description: Human-readable reference annotation source. / 人类可读参考标注来源。

dataset_id.description: M2 external synchronized dataset identity. / M2 外部同步数据集标识。

training_split_id.description: Required materialized training split identity; an empty or implicit split is forbidden. / 必填的已物化训练划分标识；禁止空值或隐含划分。

preprocessing_profile_id.description: Registered external-data polyphase mapping profile. / 已注册外部数据多相映射配置。

algorithm_id.description: Frozen training-only median transit-delay algorithm. / 冻结的仅训练折中位传导延迟算法。

sha256.description: Lower-case SHA-256 digest. / 小写 SHA-256 摘要。
